attributes.action: Ban the sale of fireworks to the general public, allowing event displays only.
attributes.additional_details:
No shop sales of fireworks to the general public, with the exception of sparklers.
All event organisers must be licenced.
Sales only to licence holders, by specific suppliers.
Advanced notice (a min. of 3 consecutive days online, or on display; to include the display date, or a letter outlining dates and times to the affected properties) to enable safety provision for pets and people on whom fireworks have an adverse effect.
Licences for special occasions should be available all year round.
attributes.background:
Ban the sale of fireworks to the general public. 

Thus reducing accidents, animal distress and death, and human distress.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
